rule: C is append-only product learning from user feedback and real field evidence; it may refine A but cannot silently erase A.
accumulated_requirements: No micro-beta install chain; user keeps a usable baseline while one coherent successor is built.
GitHub/CI must simulate and detect problems upstream before asking the user to test.
Target screenshots trigger automatic visual counter-audit; user must not enumerate every defect.
Communication is P0: Gmail START before work, Gmail END + provider ACK + durable END_ACK before final app reply.
Continuity must survive lost app messages, bad network, verification holds and new conversations.
Only one human installer path; no ambiguous/stale APK and no downgrade disguised as latest.
Real user experience outranks optimistic Android bandwidth estimates.
No fake 100/100 quality score and no unsupported 'comfortable' wording.
Mobile data UI must use human MB/GB, not force technical MiB vocabulary.
Interface must be simple/human/blue, but the product must go beyond interface and provide actual network intelligence and assistance.
Network improvement must be measurable: detect→act→remeasure→maintain or stop; no causal claim from requestBandwidthUpdate alone.
Repeated ineffective actions must stop/escalate rather than repeat theatre.
Battery/RAM/thermal/data guards are visible product requirements, not hidden implementation details.
Field findings become regression tests/durable evidence.
Strong stabilizer remains required as future core value but must pass measurable benefit, battery/RAM/latency/DNS/watchdog/rollback gates before activation.
